bundles.label: quarantined_local_candidate_bundle
bundles.interpretation: Vehicle/dispenser counts are header-level candidates only. A separate bounded candidate review found no common-clock station-to-vehicle contract eligible for scoring.

decision.reason: The recheck confirms additional local signal volume, but unit semantics, calibration, rights, event linkage and synchronized vehicle channels are not attested. No validation gate is promoted from schema candidates alone.

claim_boundary: Aggregate local schema and bounded candidate-screen results only. This record does not publish raw measurements or source identity and does not validate a vehicle fill, safety distance, field operation or certification.
